<style>
@keyframes sgAkkuLinks {
0% {
background-position: 140% 0
}
100% {
background-position: -40% 0
}
}
@keyframes sgAkkuRechts {
0% {
background-position: -40% 0
}
100% {
background-position: 140% 0
}
}
@keyframes sgFlussRechts {
from {
background-position: 0 0
}
to {
background-position: 28px 0
}
}
@keyframes sgFlussLinks {
from {
background-position: 28px 0
}
to {
background-position: 0 0
}
}
@keyframes sgFlussRunter {
from {
background-position: 0 0
}
to {
background-position: 0 28px
}
}
.sg-h-ruhe {
background-color: #2D6E99
}
.sg-h-laden {
background-color: #2D6E99;
background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.16), transparent);
background-size: 35% 100%;
background-repeat: no-repeat;
animation: sgAkkuRechts 3.5s ease-in-out infinite
}
.sg-h-entladen {
background-color: #2D6E99;
background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.14), transparent);
background-size: 35% 100%;
background-repeat: no-repeat;
animation: sgAkkuLinks 5s ease-in-out infinite
}
.sg-fl-r {
animation: sgFlussRechts .9s linear infinite
}
.sg-fl-l {
animation: sgFlussLinks .9s linear infinite
}
.sg-fl-d {
animation: sgFlussRunter .9s linear infinite
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
.sg-h-laden, .sg-h-entladen, .sg-fl-r, .sg-fl-l, .sg-fl-d {
animation: none
}
}
</style>
